name: membase
description: Connect ChatGPT to Membase persistent memory over MCP — memory search and store, wiki, and cross-session handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent memory across sessions — search, store, wiki, and handoffs.
interface.longDescription: Membase provides persistent long-term memory for ChatGPT using hybrid vector search and knowledge graphs. Share context across sessions, remember your preferences and past decisions, and maintain project continuity without re-explaining everything.
interface.instructions: Sign up at app.membase.so to get started. Connect your ChatGPT account via OAuth in under a minute.
